translationRepairs: Ma Renyu was summoned forward and, at the twang of the bowstring, was struck dead.)〉
Ma Renyu was summoned forward and, at the twang of the bowstring, struck them dead.)〉

Prior unit has 城卒詬罵 with attendants unable to reach them; 召仁瑀至，應弦而斃 makes Renyu the archer and the silent subject of 斃 the abusive soldiers, not Renyu. The proposed active wording restores that agency.
Renyu was summoned; at the twang of the bowstring he was struck dead.)〉
Renyu was summoned; at the twang of the bowstring they were struck dead.)〉
The silent patient of 應弦而斃 is the cursing garrison of the prior sentence; Renyu is summoned to shoot. Replacing “he was struck dead” with “they were struck dead” corrects the false victim reading.
At the time Zhao Kuangyin was north of Chuzhou city. Day and night he kept his armor on, braved arrows and stones himself, and led troops up onto the wall.
At the time the present sovereign was north of Chuzhou city. Day and night he kept his armor on, braved arrows and stones himself, and led troops up onto the wall.
Focus unit has 時今上在楚州城北; 今上 is the historiographical “present sovereign,” and the idiomatic “Zhao Kuangyin” invents a personal name absent from the Chinese.

That same day Li Jing sent his minister Liu Chengyu to offer Lu, Shu, Qi, and Huang and the other four prefectures and to request that the Yangtze serve as the boundary. The emperor replied: "The emperor respectfully inquires after the ruler of Jiangnan.

That same day Li Jing sent his minister Liu Chengyu to offer the four prefectures of Lu, Shu, Qi, and Huang and to request that the Yangtze serve as the boundary. The emperor replied: "The emperor respectfully inquires after the ruler of Jiangnan.
Chinese 廬、舒、蘄、黃等四州 lists exactly those four prefectures; “and the other four” wrongly implies additional ones. “The four prefectures of Lu, Shu, Qi, and Huang” matches the count.
On jiaxu Cang Prefecture military governor Zhang Yongde, pursuant to edict, went to the northern frontier because the Khitan had violated the border.
On jiaxu Chan Prefecture military governor Zhang Yongde, pursuant to edict, went to the northern frontier because the Khitan had violated the border.
Focus unit has 澶州節度使; 澶州 is Chan Prefecture (Chanzhou), whereas Cang Prefecture would be 滄州. The proposed place-name correction is required.
On jiaxu Cang Prefecture military governor Zhang Yongde, pursuant to edict, went to the northern frontier because the Khitan had violated the border.
On jiaxu Chan Prefecture military governor Zhang Yongde, pursuant to edict, went to the northern frontier because the Khitan had violated the border.
The same unit names 澶州, not 滄州. Chan Prefecture correctly replaces the literal’s false Cang Prefecture.
In eliminating the wicked and quelling calamity you have already established extraordinary merit; grinding mountains and swearing by rivers—I how could I forget a rich reward.
In eliminating the wicked and quelling calamity you have already established extraordinary merit; grinding mountains and swearing by rivers—how could I forget a rich reward.
Chinese 予豈忘於豐報 is a single rhetorical question with 予 as subject; the literal’s duplicated “I how could I” is ungrammatical. Dropping the stray “I” restores the question.
On bingchen Grand Master of Ceremonies Zhao Li, acting administrator of Suzhou's military and civil affairs, was stripped of office for laxity in investigation and prosecution.

On bingchen Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhao Li, acting administrator of Su Prefecture's military and civil affairs, was stripped of his name and office for laxity in investigation and prosecution.
Focus unit has 太常博士…趙礪除名…權知宿州軍州事: 太常博士 is Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, 除名 strips name and office, and 宿州 is Su Prefecture, not Suzhou/蘇州.
On guiyou Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Siran reported defeating more than a thousand Hedong rebel troops below West Mountain and taking five hundred heads.
On guiyou Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang reported defeating more than a thousand Hedong rebel troops below West Mountain and taking five hundred heads.
The personal name is 陳思讓; 讓 is ràng, so Chen Sirang. “Chen Siran” misreads 讓 and must be corrected.
On guiyou Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Siran reported defeating more than a thousand Hedong rebel troops below West Mountain and taking five hundred heads.
On guiyou Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang reported defeating more than a thousand Hedong rebel troops below West Mountain and taking five hundred heads.
Literal repeats the same wrong romanization of 陳思讓. Chen Sirang restores the correct reading of 讓.

(The 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records the original edict: Though the realm is at peace, the common people are not yet at ease. In the second watch while reading books I compared the methods of former worthies for enriching custom.

(The 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records the original edict: I, though the realm is at peace, see that the common people are not yet at ease; in the second watch while reading books I compared the methods of former worthies for enriching custom.
The edict opens 朕以寰宇雖安，蒸民未泰; idiomatic dropped the first-person 朕以 framing. Restoring “I, though…” matches the Chinese and the literal.
On jiwei Zhaoyi Li Jun reported capturing Changqing Stockade in Liao Prefecture and taking the Northern Han-appointed Ci Prefecture governor Li Zaixing.
On jiwei Zhaoyi Li Jun reported capturing Changqing Stockade in Liao Prefecture and taking the illegitimately appointed Ci Prefecture governor Li Zaixing.
Focus unit has 偽命磁州刺史; 偽命 means illegitimately appointed. “Northern Han-appointed” invents a polity not named in the unit.

On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was appointed Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Siran was appointed Hua Prefecture acting military governor.

On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was appointed Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang was appointed Hua Prefecture acting military governor.
The appointee is again 陳思讓; 讓 is rang, so Chen Sirang. Correcting Siran to Sirang fixes the personal-name error.

On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was made Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Siran was made Hua Prefecture acting military governor.

On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Deng Prefecture was transferred to garrison Bin Prefecture; Song Yanwo of Hua Prefecture was transferred to garrison Deng Prefecture; former Hezhong military governor Wang Renhao was made Xing Prefecture military governor; and Xing Prefecture acting military governor Chen Sirang was made Hua Prefecture acting military governor.
Literal has the same Siran error for 陳思讓. Chen Sirang is the accurate romanization.

That month Li Jing of Jiangnan killed his ministers the appointed Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister Song Qiqiu, appointed Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, appointed Pacifying South Army deputy military governor Li Zhenggu, and others.

That month Li Jing of Jiangnan killed his ministers the illegitimately styled Grand Preceptor and Chief Minister Song Qiqiu, illegitimately styled Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, illegitimately styled Pacifying South Army deputy military governor Li Zhenggu, and others.
Each title is marked 偽 (偽太傅中書令、偽兵部侍郎、偽鎮南軍節度副使). Plain “appointed” drops that Zhou judgment; “illegitimately styled” restores it.
